request.promptText: Animate this Korean classroom teacher shot as a quiz introduction. Keep the same teacher identity as the reference image: white-blue gradient hair, purple eyes, Korean gat, black hanbok, black gloves. Lock the teacher in the RIGHT THIRD OF THE FRAME with body center near 75% width and keep the LEFT TWO-THIRDS as a blank green chalkboard. Do not let the teacher drift back to center. Motion: warm smile, slight forward lean, gentle palm-up presenting gesture, short glance to the board and back to camera. No repeat-after-me conducting motion. Clothing must stay plain black with no tag, no hanging placard, no badge, no letters, and no symbols. No readable text, no subtitles, no watermarks, no extra students.
